---
title: "Eventfulness vs loudness"
description: "Relate ISOEventful to N5 loudness with a regression line per location."
date: 2026-01-20
categories: [acoustic metrics, seaborn]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-eventfulness-vs-loudness
#| fig-alt: "ISOEventful against N5 by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

sns.lmplot(
    data=data,
    x="N5",
    y="ISOEventful",
    hue="LocationID",
    palette="colorblind",
    height=6,
    aspect=1.5,
)
plt.title("Loudness (N5) and eventfulness")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
